name: io.github.LarryWalkerDEV/immostage
title: ImmoStage Virtual Staging
description: AI virtual staging for real estate (DACH) — stage empty rooms, beautify floor plans and generate marketing packages via MCP. Connect with OAuth 2.0, no API key or sign-up e-mail required.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can connect WITHOUT this header: the server answers 401 with a WWW-Authenticate/RFC 9728 pointer and the client registers itself via OAuth 2.0 dynamic client registration — no key, no e-mail, no approval. Use a Bearer key only for scripts and CI. Self-service key at app.immostage.ai -> Einstellungen -> "Claude / MCP Zugang".
